notes.title: 🚇 Next station: Achievements
notes.content: Achievements added! New dymamic trap system. AI bug fixed and other small changes!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - "Muchaaachos" patch
notes.content:
Hi there!

Has been a month since the last update, but finally here is it 🥳

Here is a short brief:
• Spanish localization
• Traps now do damage (Be careful 👀)
• Added a new healing item.
• Dynamic spawn added to this item (In the near future, we will be implementing this in the traps too)
• Changes in the game pace, Richard is more chill than before.

🤔 So, what's next?
We are planning to expand the map, add a new puzzle (DBD player gonna love it!) and tweak the AI a bit.
Oh, and checkpoints!

See ya!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
